**What & why:** The hero's rotating `.platform` pill (built in [VPHomeHero.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPHomeHero.vue#L59-L179), styled in [pantoken.css](docs/.vitepress/theme/pantoken.css#L423-L520)) becomes interactive: hover/focus/active pauses the roller, click opens a categorized dropdown (Formats/Renderers/Bundlers/Platforms/Design) with icons + brand colors — modeled on the package-manager picker in [CommandCycleRow.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CommandCycleRow.vue#L164-L189), not the language picker's native `<select>`. 1. **Data model** — extract the 31-item `PLATFORMS` const into a new `platform-options.ts`, add `category` (`formats`/`renderers`/`bundlers`/`platforms`/`design`) and a single dark-hero-safe `color` per item (pulled from the installed `simple-icons` package's `hex` field, not guessed), plus one new `figma` entry so `design` isn't empty.
2. **Pause wiring** *(depends on 1)* — track hover/focus state on the pill, replace the bare `setInterval` with schedule/clear helpers, extract the swap logic into `goToIndex()` shared by both auto-advance and manual picks.
3. **Dropdown menu** *(depends on 1, 2)* — build a `role="menu"` panel grouped by category (headings reused from existing `sidebar.apiGroups.*` i18n keys — no new translations needed), full keyboard support (Enter/Space/Arrows/Escape), closes immediately on pick but stays paused until true blur.

- [docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPHomeHero.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPHomeHero.vue) — pause/resume + dropdown logic
- `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/platform-options.ts` (new) — categorized/colored option data

1. Manual homepage check: hover/focus/mousedown pauses; click opens grouped menu; pick snaps + stays paused; blur resumes forward from the picked item.
2. Keyboard-only pass (Tab/Enter/Arrows/Escape) — verify `aria-expanded`/focus never gets lost.
3. `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — roller stays static but dropdown still works.
4. `vp check` across touched files.
5. Contrast check of brand colors against the hero's translucent pill background.

**Decisions**
- Hand-rolled menu (icons+colors), not native `<select>` — per your steer.
- Categories fixed order: formats, renderers, bundlers, platforms, design; adding a `figma` entry so `design` has content.
- Select closes menu but doesn't resume; only true blur resumes, continuing forward from the picked index.

{"command": "create", "path": "/memories/session/plan.md", "file_text": "# Plan: Synced platform pill + terminal command + categorized picker

## Scope (expanded from original "just add a dropdown" ask)
Three things, all interdependent:
1. The hero's rotating `.platform` pill pauses on hover/focus/active.
2. Clicking it opens a categorized (Formats/Renderers/Bundlers/Platforms/Design) dropdown, styled
   like the package-manager popover in CommandCycleRow.vue (icons + brand colors, not a native
   `<select>`). Picking an item jumps the pill there and keeps it paused until blur.
3. **New:** the mock terminal in GetStartedTabs.vue is synced to the pill: each platform gets a real
   `pantoken` CLI command (or an npm-install command, for platforms with no CLI verb), and the
   terminal's type/backspace animation is driven by the *same* cycle as the pill's slide animation:
   platform slides in → command types → holds → backspace-deletes → platform slides out → next
   platform slides in. The `<pm>` prefix (vpx/pnpm/deno/bun/npm/yarn) keeps advancing every cycle,
   independently wrapping at its own length, in lockstep with the platform index (both odometer
   counters tick once per full cycle). Hovering/focusing *either* the pill or the terminal pauses
   both.

## Verified CLI command mapping (read from actual source, not guessed)
Source: [packages/cli/README.md](packages/cli/README.md), [packages/cli/src/index.ts](packages/cli/src/index.ts#L48-L64)
(`SUPPORTED` set), [packages/scaffold/src/index.ts](packages/scaffold/src/index.ts#L81-L83) (`SCAFFOLD_PLATFORMS`
derived from `packages/scaffold/templates/*` directory names), [packages/scaffold/src/cli.ts](packages/scaffold/src/cli.ts#L117-L124)
(`PLATFORM_DISPLAY_LABELS`, incl. `components: "HTML"` / alias `html`→`components`).

**`pantoken generate <target>`** (10 of our 32): swift, android, compose, flutter, wordpress,
drupal, rust, jekyll, hugo, mintlify.

**`pantoken create <target>`** (7 of our 32): react, vue, angular, svelte, web-components, next,
and **web → `create components`** (arg differs from display name; `html` is an accepted alias).

**Install-only, no pantoken CLI verb** (15 of our 32) — shown as `<pm-install-verb> @pantoken/<pkg>`:
astro, vite, webpack, tailwind, postcss, **sass → package is `@pantoken/scss`** (arg differs),
stylus, storybook, bootstrap, docusaurus, shadcn, mui, foundation, tinymce, figma.

Package manager launcher forms (dlx-style, existing, for `generate`/`create`) vs. install-verb forms
(new, for the install-only third):
| pm id | dlx launcher (existing) | install-verb launcher (new) |
|---|---|---|
| vpx | `vpx ` | `vp add ` *(confirmed via viteplus.dev/guide — "Manage Dependencies" section)* |
| pnpm | `pnpm dlx ` | `pnpm add ` |
| deno | `deno run npm:` | `deno add npm:` |
| bun | `bunx ` | `bun add ` |
| npm | `npx ` | `npm install ` |
| yarn | `yarn dlx ` | `yarn add ` |

Full command text per platform = `<pm launcher variant> + "pantoken " + verb + " " + arg` for
generate/create, or `<pm install-verb launcher> + "@pantoken/" + arg` for install-only.

## Data model
New `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/platform-options.ts`:
```
interface PlatformCommand {
  verb: "generate" | "create" | "install";
  arg: string; // CLI target name, or npm scope suffix for install
}
interface PlatformOption {
  name: string; label: string; icon: string;
  category: "formats" | "renderers" | "bundlers" | "platforms" | "design";
  color: string; // single hex, dark-hero-safe (see prior research: hero bg is always dark)
  command: PlatformCommand;
}
PLATFORM_OPTIONS: PlatformOption[]  // existing 31 + new `figma` entry (design category)
PLATFORM_CATEGORY_ORDER = ["formats","renderers","bundlers","platforms","design"]
```
Category assignments (unchanged from prior research): formats = web, sass, stylus · renderers =
react, vue, angular, svelte, astro, web-components, mui, bootstrap, shadcn, docusaurus, mintlify,
storybook, tinymce, foundation · bundlers = vite, webpack, tailwind, postcss, next · platforms =
swift, android, compose, flutter, rust, drupal, hugo, jekyll, wordpress · design = figma (new).

Brand `color` per item: pull real hex from the installed `simple-icons` package's `hex` field via a
throwaway script (don't hardcode from memory — see user memory `dependency-versions.md`); adjust any
that read poorly on the dark hero bg.

Extend `pmOptions` in GetStartedTabs.vue (or move it alongside `platform-options.ts`) with an
`installLauncher` field per entry per the table above.

## Shared composable — the core architectural change
Currently two independent systems exist:
- VPHomeHero.vue: raw DOM `setInterval` every 5000ms, sliding `.platform-label`/`.platform-glyph`
  (450ms transition), no Vue reactivity.
- GetStartedTabs.vue + [useCommandCycle.ts](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/useCommandCycle.ts): a
  `phase` state machine (`idle → typing → paused → deleting → idle`) driving char-by-char
  type/backspace of a *fixed* `suffix` (`BASE_COMMAND = "create-pantoken-app"`) after a per-pm
  `launcher`, advancing `activeIndex` through `pmOptions` once per `idle` tick.

These must merge into **one new composable**, `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/usePlatformTerminalCycle.ts`,
instantiated once (likely in GetStartedTabs.vue, since it already owns `isPaused`/`reducedMotion`
plumbing for the terminal, and imported into VPHomeHero.vue) — per your steer, a shared
composable/module, not a prop-drilled ref bag.

- State: `pmIndex`, `platformIndex` (both refs), `phase: "entering" | "typing" | "paused" |
  "deleting" | "exiting"` (extends today's 4-phase machine with two new phases that own the pill's
  slide timing — replacing VPHomeHero's independent 450ms transition with a phase the terminal side
  also watches), `charCount`, `cursorBlink`.
- Timing: `enteringMs`/`exitingMs` = today's `TRANSITION_MS` (450ms, matching the CSS
  `transition: transform 0.45s ease`); `typeMs`/`deleteMs`/`holdMs`/`blinkMs` = today's
  `useCommandCycle` timings, reused as-is.
- On completing a full cycle (end of `exiting`): `pmIndex = (pmIndex + 1) % pmOptions.length`,
  `platformIndex = (platformIndex + 1) % PLATFORM_OPTIONS.length` — two independent modulo counters
  ticking together, not a shared/coupled index (per your "odometer" answer).
- Computed: `activePlatform`, `activePm`, `activeLauncher` (dlx or install-verb form, chosen by
  `activePlatform.command.verb === "install"`), `fullCommandText` (`activeLauncher + commandBody`),
  `typedLauncher`/`typedSuffix` slices (same slicing approach as `useCommandCycle`, generalized to
  the combined launcher+body string instead of a fixed suffix).
- `pause()`/`resume()`: same semantics as today's `GetStartedTabs.pause()`/`resume()`
  (`manuallyPaused` still wins), but now the **single** source both VPHomeHero and GetStartedTabs
  call into.
- `pick(platformIndex)`: sets `platformIndex` directly (pm untouched), forces `phase` to `"paused"`
  with `charCount` at full length (mirrors `pauseAtFull`), does **not** auto-resume — matches the
  existing dropdown decision (stays paused until blur) and now also re-types the terminal to match
  (per your "yes, retype" answer).
- Exposes `start()`/`stop()` for mount/unmount symmetry with the current composable.

### 1. Data + composable *(foundational, no template changes yet)*
- Add `platform-options.ts` (data model above).
- Add `usePlatformTerminalCycle.ts` (state machine above), unit-testable independent of Vue DOM

- `CommandCycleRow.vue` currently assumes one fixed `launcher` per `option` and one fixed `suffix`

- `enterTerminal()`/`leaveTerminal()`/`focusin`/`focusout` on `.gs-terminal` now call the shared

  - on entering `"entering"`: run the existing slide-in DOM logic (new label/glyph enters, old one

Fixed by:
- Giving `slideOut()` and `slideIn()` separate timer variables (`exitTimeoutId`/`enterTimeoutId`).
- Capturing the outgoing icon/label into local `const`s at the moment `slideOut()` runs, so the delayed removal always targets the correct (old) elements regardless of later reassignment.
